# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): commands, architecture rules and conventions.

Before writing React Native code, read `.claude/skills/react-native-best-practices/SKILL.md` and the reference
it points to for the task. Navigation: `.claude/skills/react-navigation/SKILL.md`. Tests:
`.claude/skills/react-native-testing/SKILL.md`. Where a skill and AGENTS.md disagree, AGENTS.md wins.

To add a feature, screen or endpoint, follow `.claude/skills/add-feature/SKILL.md`,
`.claude/skills/add-screen/SKILL.md` or `.claude/skills/add-endpoint/SKILL.md`: they start from `pnpm gen`.
